episodes.title: Real American Heroes
episodes.summary: After thwarting an arms dealer's deadly plans, a special forces team celebrates the end of their mission with a rager until sobering news ends the party.

episodes.title: Born in the U.S.S.R.
episodes.summary: The team races to Area 52 to grill Koslov and his buyer, and Maya heads to the strip club with a new friend who threatens to sabotage their mission.

episodes.title: Craps
episodes.summary: On deadline, the group's search for Litvin leads them to an even bigger discovery. In the air, Paul has bizarre visions while maneuvering the Vulture.

episodes.title: Walks of Shame
episodes.summary: With the Vulture grounded, the team splits: McKnight and Ava find an ally, Gomez helps Maya overcome her fear, and Trunk and Lana plot an exit strategy.

episodes.title: Shots! Shots! Shots!
episodes.summary: The agents infiltrate the lake house to seize the nuke. But as tensions rise within the Russian ranks, the team finds themselves caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: From Vegas with Love
episodes.summary: The clock is ticking as the women search for clues in a nightclub and the men deal with Elvis impersonators. Elsewhere, Hagerty may have met his match.

episodes.title: Make It Rain
episodes.summary: As the FBI takes over for Ava and the team, a close Koslov associate steps up. On the Strip, plans for an exchange unravel when pandemonium breaks out.

episodes.title: Last Call
episodes.summary: The mission kicks into high gear when the squad learns shocking news about the nuke. It's all hands on deck to stop the explosion before it's too late.
